translations.web: He answered, “Don’t be afraid; for those who are with us are more than those who are with them.”
translations.bsb: “Do not be afraid,” Elisha answered, “for those who are with us are more than those who are with them.”
translations.kjv: And he answered, Fear not: for they that be with us are more than they that be with them.
translations.asv: And he answered, Fear not; for they that are with us are more than they that are with them.
